title: Analytics
description: What your published posts did, measured the same way every time.

state.empty: Nothing published yet. Results appear here after Jemip publishes your first post.
state.immature: Measuring. Engagement is final 7 days after a post goes out. Final for {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} on {date}.
state.unavailable: {platform} doesn't share engagement data with Jemip, so we show your publishing activity there instead.
state.thin: {n, plural, one {# measured post} other {# measured posts}} so far. A typical rate appears from 5.
state.thinWins: {n, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} had a usual to compare against. A win count appears from 5.
state.noPatternYet: No pattern has enough evidence yet. Jemip only learns a pattern from at least 10 posts across 3 campaigns.

typicalIqr: {n} posts measured. Typical engagement rate: {rate} (middle half of posts {lo}–{hi}).
wins: {wins} of {n} posts beat your usual engagement.
monthPairSuppressed: A side-by-side view appears when both months have at least 5 measured posts.

exclusions.summary: {measured} of {published, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} measured.

disclosure.usual: Usual = your median over the previous 90 days on X, or the history you imported.
disclosure.usualUpdates: 'Usual' updates as you post, so this is not a measure of overall progress.
disclosure.importSeed: Compared against the history you imported.
disclosure.engagementOnly: This measures engagement, not signups or revenue.
disclosure.linkedinCount: LinkedIn results compare engagement counts, which also rise as your audience grows.

coverage.generated: Covers {k} of {n} measured posts. Posts written outside Jemip's generator aren't classified.

breakdown.row: Posts with {value}: {wins} of {n} beat your usual.
breakdown.describes: This describes past posts, not the reason for their results.
breakdown.hookNote: As classified by the AI when writing, not independently checked.
breakdown.none: No comparison yet: each value needs 10 measured posts.

account.unrecorded: Account not recorded or since removed

activity.line: {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} published on {platform} ({account}).
activity.total: {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} published, {prev} the month before.
activity.campaigns: Posts came from {withPosts, plural, one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}. {retrospectivesCompleted, plural, one {# campaign completed its retrospective} other {# campaigns completed their retrospective}} this month.

line.trend: a 12-month view of your typical engagement and posts published.
line.breakdowns: win share by post role, format, origin, length and call to action.
line.patterns: patterns observed across your campaigns, each with its evidence.

postsPerMonth.title: Posts published per month
postsPerMonth.summary: {total} posts published between {first} and {last}, shown by month.

trend.title: Typical engagement rate by month
trend.summary: Typical engagement rate for {platform} between {first} and {last}; months with fewer than 5 measured posts are left blank.

winShare.summary: Share of posts that beat your usual, by {dimension}.

posts.title: Every post
posts.description: Each published post with where it stands.

filters.none: Account not recorded or since removed

state.soFar: So far, as of {asOf}: {likes} likes, {comments} comments, {shares} shares, {impressions} impressions. Final on {finalOn}.

pattern.above: On {platform}, {subject} beat your usual engagement in {wins} of {n} posts ({campaigns, plural, one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}).
pattern.below: On {platform}, {subject} were below your usual engagement in {wins} of {n} posts ({campaigns, plural, one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}).
pattern.above_count: On {platform}, {subject} beat your usual engagement count in {wins} of {n} posts ({campaigns, plural, one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}).
pattern.below_count: On {platform}, {subject} were below your usual engagement count in {wins} of {n} posts ({campaigns, plural, one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}).

report.title: Monthly reports
report.description: One report per month, kept as it was generated.

list.empty: Reports appear here from the 10th of each month, for the month before.

report.stub: No posts were published in {month}, so there is nothing to measure.

ratedPosts.title: Three X posts by engagement rate
ratedPosts.caveat: A post seen by few people can have a high rate.

report.lateOutcomes: Posts measured after {date} are not included.
report.notInReport: This report was generated before your plan included this section.

methodology.median: The typical rate is the median engagement rate of the measured posts: half were above it and half below. Below 10 posts the range is lowest to highest; from 10 it is the middle half of posts.
methodology.maturity: A post is measured 7 days after it goes out. Newer posts count as published but not yet measured.
methodology.exclusions: Posts without usable data are listed with the reason and are not included in any rate.
methodology.usual: Usual is your median over the previous 90 days on X, or the history you imported. It updates as you post, so it is not a measure of overall progress.
methodology.floors: A typical rate is shown from 5 measured posts. Comparisons by post type need 10 measured posts per value. Jemip only learns a pattern from at least 10 posts across 3 campaigns; numbers shown here are descriptions, not lessons.
methodology.xOnly: Engagement rates are measured on X only. Other platforms show publishing activity.
methodology.descriptive: Breakdowns describe past posts. They overlap, and they are not the reason for any result.
methodology.engagementOnly: This measures engagement, not signups or revenue.

setting.label: Email each report to
setting.help: The report is always kept here. This only controls the email.
setting.forbidden: Only the business owner can change this.
